name: Parts of the Swarm
summary: In Thousand Needles, you find a cracked silithid carapace and see how tightly its plating is woven. Korran at the Crossroads wants to study more of these creatures.

sections.title: A Curious Carapace
sections.body: You find silithid chitin woven tighter than anything you have seen. The creature's body shows great strength and advanced development. Korran at the Crossroads wants to learn more about the creatures and their origins. He asks for one silithid heart, five silithid talons and three intact silithid carapaces.

sections.title: Specimens for Korran
sections.body: Korran welcomes the specimens. Along with the eggs found in the Field of Giants, they give him a beginning in learning what manner of creatures the insects are and what they seek.

aliases: turn in parts of the swarm
faq.answer: Korran at the Crossroads wants the silithid parts so he can study more of these creatures.

aliases: how to start parts of the swarm
faq.answer: It begins when you inspect a cracked silithid carapace in Thousand Needles.
Korran wants one silithid heart, five silithid talons and three intact silithid carapaces.

faq.q: Why would Korran want to study silithid?
faq.answer: Studying more silithid might reveal the creatures' nature and origins.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you bring the specimens to Korran at the Crossroads.
